brief.headline: Close the ₹1.26 Cr gap to our cheapest dextrose price and line up a second source — we're their ₹21.21 Cr customer with three qualified makers ready

priceAsk.summary: Match the ₹66.48/KG we already pay Sayaji Industries
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹68.45/KG — that's 3.0% more than the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP. The market asking price band is ₹60–81/kg with typical deals at ₹66–73/kg, so our target sits right in the normal range. Closing this gap saves us ₹1.26 Cr a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days sooner in return for a price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier frees up ₹87.17 L of our cash, so any discount we get for that still leaves us ahead

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit or debt. What we do know: we spend ₹21.21 Cr with them — 56% of all our Dextrose — making us a major customer. They have real competition: Sayaji already beats their price, and we've found three more listed dextrose makers (Tirupati Starch, Gulshan Polyols, Sanstar) plus global players like Roquette and Ingredion as leads to qualify. Because we can't gauge their financial room, we push firmly on price to match our best, dangle faster payment as a sweetener, and make clear we're bringing on a second source whether or not they move.

evidence.point: We pay them 3.0% more than our cheapest dextrose supplier
Closing that gap saves us this much every year
They supply over half our Dextrose — we're a big customer
Market asking prices show our target is fair and achievable
Paying them 15 days faster ties up this much of our cash

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller making Dextrose Anhydrous IV-fluid grade — exact form match; a lead to qualify (verify IP monograph CoA before switching)

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch and polyol maker, established dextrose supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja; a lead to qualify

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major, pharma-grade dextrose with premium quality systems, revenue ₹2898.05 Cr — a lead to qualify

risks: They're our only big source (56% of Dextrose) — if they walk or stumble, our supply is exposed until we qualify and ramp a second supplier
No public financials means we can't see cash stress or stability — watch for sudden delivery or quality problems that might signal trouble
Pressing too hard without a qualified backup in place could push them to cut us loose; make sure at least one alternate (Tirupati or Gulshan) is audited and pricing before the final push
If they agree to faster payment for a discount, lock the new price in writing so they don't claw it back later
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, and we'd like to talk about aligning your Dextrose price with the ₹66.48/KG we pay our other supplier — and in return we can look at paying you faster.
